updates.note: Management mentions target of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores for gold loan AUM.
updates.quote: AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.

updates.note: Reiterates consumer AI platform launch timeline for May, June 2027.
updates.quote: altogether new consumer AI platform emerge by May, June '27

updates.note: Management updated the new customer addition guidance from 15-17 million to 18-20 million.
updates.quote: we revised the number of customers, which we want to add to the franchise from 15-17 to almost 18-20

updates.note: Reiterates current AUM growth guidance corridor.
updates.quote: this 22% to 24% corridor that we have given for AUM growth

new_promises.statement: Expect gold loan branches to reach 2,700 to 2,800 by the end of the year.
new_promises.quote: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Deliver 25 to 40 basis points improvement in opex to NTI for FY27.
new_promises.quote: Overall, we are confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY '27 in opex to NTI.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain

new_promises.statement: Digital platform will deliver INR 50,000 crores of business this year.
new_promises.quote: this year the digital platform will deliver INR50,000 crores of business.
new_promises.speaker: Rajeev Jain
